workflow.title: From Brief to Launch
workflow.subtitle: A structured, transparent, and measurable development process from initial brief to official launch.

1.title: Project Discussion & Brief
1.desc: Initial discussion to understand business needs, determine website type, map out page structure, and agree on the visual direction.

2.title: Asset & Content Gathering
2.desc: Collecting essential materials from the client, such as logos, product/event photos, profile texts, contact info, and required guest or legal data.

3.title: UI Design & Code Slicing
3.desc: Translating design concepts into modern, clean, and responsive code built with Next.js/React and Tailwind CSS.

4.title: Testing & Speed Optimization
4.desc: Comprehensive Quality Assurance (QA) including cross-device responsiveness checks, page loading speed tests, and basic SEO setup.

5.title: Client Review & Revisions
5.desc: A live demo link is provided for mutual review. Necessary adjustments are made according to package revision quotas to ensure exact results.

6.title: Launch & Handover
6.desc: Deploying the site to the client's custom domain, handing over repository/credentials, and providing administrative guides for easy management.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Have a unique concept or confused about choosing a package? Talk to us directly. We're ready to bring your dream website to life!

questions.title: What is the estimated completion time for a website project?
questions.content: Completion takes between 3 to 14 business days, depending on the scale and complexity of the selected package (Landing Page, MSME, or Corporate Profile).

questions.title: What framework or technologies do you use?
questions.content: We build with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to deliver ultra-fast, secure, and Google SEO-optimized websites.

questions.title: Do I need to prepare my own domain and hosting?
questions.content: Depending on your selected package, you can bring your own domain and hosting or leverage our turnkey hosting infrastructure.

questions.title: How does the payment system and revision workflow work?
questions.content: Payments are made in milestone stages (down payment and final balance upon go-live). Every package includes revision quotas to guarantee your satisfaction.

questions.title: Do you provide guides for managing the website?
questions.content: Yes, we provide comprehensive PDF documentation and video tutorials to help you easily manage and update your website content.

questions.title: Can I request a custom design tailored to my brand?
questions.content: Absolutely! Every package can be customized to match your brand identity—including color palettes, visual aesthetics, content layout, and page structure.

questions.title: Is post-launch maintenance or content update available?
questions.content: Yes, we offer ongoing maintenance and post-launch update plans to keep your website secure, fresh, and continuously evolving.
